card.name: Words just before him, his, or He
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs right before a masculine pronoun such as him, his, or He, usually in a text about a male person or God. Also fires once on a Spanish storage verb.

modes.label: Before male pronoun
modes.description: A linking word or verb comes just before him, his, or Him referring to a man or God.
modes.example: In all thy ways acknowledge him,<< and>> he shall direct thy paths.

modes.label: Spanish storage verb
modes.description: The start of almacenar in Spanish storage instructions.
modes.example: Mantener el medicamento protegido del calor, luz y humedad,<< almacen>>ar a no más de 30

card.writes: It pushes toward male-referring words like wife and his, and away from female pronouns such as she and her.
card.plain: It fires on a word just before a he/him/his, and it steers the model away from writing she or her.
